name: LongMemEval-S cleaned fixed seven-case retrieval smoke test
selection: Group abstention separately, sort strata lexicographically, sort each stratum by SHA256(question_id + NUL + seed), then round-robin. The default selects the first seven cases before results are observed.
protocol: Full untruncated per-question history, both message roles, native kp chunks, deduplicated session ranking. Raw IDs and gold labels stay in evaluator files. CLI init/add/search only; no direct database writes.
abstention: Run the unanswerable query, record retrieval outputs, exclude it from evidence-recall denominators. Answer abstention has not been evaluated.
claim_limit: A seven-case custom retrieval smoke test is not end-to-end accuracy, the official user-only retrieval protocol, a statistically representative estimate, or a leaderboard score. No source dataset is vendored in this directory.
